sdk.currentGetter: null when no Runtime or native Runtime already stopped

businessLogin.trustedCallbackID: server-generated canonical UUID bound to verified callback/login/identity mapping; never browser override
businessLogin.beforeIssue: commit shared unique LoginIntent claim unknown
businessLogin.sameCallbackRepeat: local receipt only, never Issue again
businessLogin.sameCredentialSlot: unique tenant/resource/session/expectedRevision prevents replacement with another callback ID
businessLogin.unknownRecovery: observe exact original G-B Install receipt; missing observation is not noncommit proof
businessLogin.newLoginAfterClosed: explicit fresh verified callback, same immutable identity, original session CAS

runtimeAdmission.bootstrapAndActions: BFF current callback receipt plus G-B Access and existing native authorization
runtimeAdmission.nativeSessionTaskRunMapping: original private mapping preserved; new local Runtime does not substitute history
runtimeAdmission.controllerRelease: best effort under current business/native authorization; local stop does not prove global immediate revocation
